properties.decision: PROPOSED, awaiting Anthony; nothing built. In plain terms: the logic rung recorded the contradiction ⊥ twenty times, once per reductio, because one shared ⊥ makes the design refuse the write as circular reasoning (a reductio's result feeds the next derivation of the same ⊥). (a) Keep one record per place a formula is derived (today's rule; the proof skill now says so). (b) Keep one record per occurrence, and let each name the formula it is an occurrence of (`same_formula_as`), so the read-back groups the twenty as one formula. (c) Let one record be concluded under several suppositions, and read its truth per supposition, so the circle through a discharged supposition is allowed: the largest change, to the core of how truth is computed.
properties.name: Is one formula used under several suppositions one record, or one record per place it is derived?
properties.rationale: Measured 2026-10-20 on the logic rung fixture (e104c2efbcc0fb6d): merging its 21 falsum records into one is refused at import with 8 circular-reasoning errors (for example inf:dma-15 → req:dma-f1 → inf:dma-15). Item 3 of req:natural-deduction-gaps-from-the-logic-rung-are-closed asks that the same formula need not be a new node each time; only (c) does that literally, and it changes how every claim's truth is read, so it is the owner's call. I recommend (b) now (cheap, honest, keeps the circle guard) and (c) only if a trial needs a shared formula to carry its truth. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
